research_questions.RQ1_modeling_mechanism: Among same-series adjacent-contest pairs sharing the same problem slot with unequal platform-published difficulty, does training with an explicit training-only slot bias b_k improve within-position statement-only accuracy of an adapted neural ranker relative to training without slot bias (A1 - A0)?
research_questions.RQ2_review_budget_decision: Under a fixed chronological manual review budget (pre-specified 30% scenario and 0%/10%/20%/30%/50% curves), which ranking and referral strategy minimizes verifiable automatic misorderings per 100 raw within-position requests?

retained_v3_evidence_roles.position_rule_contrast: Retained as motivation (91.01%–93.43% pooled vs 50.00% same-slot across CF/ABC/E1).
retained_v3_evidence_roles.rolling_selection_G: Retained cleanly (27/48 observed flips; 12/12 unconditional CIs cross zero; 58-grid not rerun for Qwen3).
retained_v3_evidence_roles.step7_prospective_abc_v1: Retained verbatim as separate prospective protocol (sha256 4057463a...; zero post-freeze contests claimed).
retained_v3_evidence_roles.external_labeling: All new Step 2/3 comparisons on historical cohorts explicitly labeled fixed-protocol retrospective comparisons, not new blind data collection.

step2_qwen3_factorial_spec.representation: L2-normalized last non-padding token hidden state -> Linear(1024, 1) scalar difficulty head f(x)

training_pairs.pairing_rule: shift0 disjoint adjacent contest pairs within (series, year, quarter)

loss_functions.with_slot_bias_F1_A1: mean_pairs log(1 + exp(-y * (f(x_i) - f(x_j) + b_{k_i} - b_{k_j}))) + lambda_b * sum_{k != A} b_k^2
loss_functions.inference_formula: f(x) only (b_k discarded at test time)

training_hyperparameters.engineering_sanity_split: CF_train <=2020 vs 2021 (never using CF_dev or test sets for code debugging)
training_hyperparameters.early_stop_metric: CF_dev_2022 within-position accuracy (earliest epoch on exact tie)

evaluation_cohorts.primary: CF_test (CF Div. 2: 274 directional / 400 candidate same-slot pairs, 101 blocks)
evaluation_cohorts.primary_contrast: A1 - A0 (seed 42 primary, plus seeds 101, 202 variability)

step3_budget_replay_spec.request_definition: Every same-slot pair (including official rating ties) inside adjacent shift0 contest-pair blocks
step3_budget_replay_spec.chronological_order: Sorted by block max_start_time ascending, then contest_b, contest_a; within block, problem_index ascending
step3_budget_replay_spec.quota_allocation: Online prefix quota Q_t = floor(budget * N_t); block referral quota dQ_t = Q_t - Q_{t-1}

auto_tie_policy.primary_operational: If automated model predicts exact tie (|s_a - s_b| <= 1e-12), fall back to Joint Ridge direction
auto_tie_policy.zero_budget_academic_reference: Also report 0% academic 0.5-tie credit baseline alongside 0% operational tie-fallback

step3_budget_replay_spec.primary_metric: verifiable_auto_errors_per_100_requests (with official ties reported separately as unverifiable)

precommitted_interpretation_rules.case_positive_A1_gt_A0: If A1 > A0 cleanly on CF Div. 2 (and transfers cleanly), claim LoRA adaptation plus training slot-bias regularization as a mechanistic improvement.
precommitted_interpretation_rules.case_lora_only: If A0 > F0 clearly while A1 - A0 ~ 0 or negative, attribute gains to LoRA representation adaptation and state honestly that training-only slot-bias subtraction does not improve within-position generalization.
precommitted_interpretation_rules.case_null_or_wide_ci: If 95% CIs across F0/F1/A0/A1 overlap zero against Joint, report effect sizes and CIs directly and anchor applied contribution on the Step 3 review-budget workflow results.
